changelog: HISTORY NOTE (2026-08-28 brand audit): entries below this line are a historical record of the website, not a list of what ships today. Several narrate features that were later deliberately removed (AUv3, drums/beat engine, RTMP plans, '12 unified tools') or that never existed as named. The one list of what is true today is ContentPipeline/CLAIMS.md in the repository.

v10.22.0: Brand-audit truth pass (2026-08-28) — site copy aligned to the shipping app (ten generative looks — that number was itself wrong and is corrected to FOUR on 2026-09-05; the reachable chip set is Rings, Water, Aurora, Depth, and the other six shaders are compiled but retired from the UI — concert pitch freely settable 380-500 Hz, v1.0 free, honest Watch/rPPG/one-way-OSC wording), and the four version numbers (version.json, sw.js, ?v= cache keys, index inline guardian) unified at this release after drifting since 10.14/10.21.

v10.21.0: Homepage — honest science section + cache fix. Added a 'Coherence — the science, measured, not mystified' section that states exactly what is real: time-domain HRV (RMSSD/SDNN/pNN50), a true frequency-domain coherence (Lomb–Scargle / Welch spectrum read in the standard HRV bands; coherence = power gathered in the ~0.1 Hz resonance peak), an optional resonance-breathing guide near 6/min (slow paced breathing raises vagally-mediated HRV — Lehrer & Gevirtz; the guide never forces a pace or asks for breath-holds), and the honest limits (chest strap = ground truth; wrist/camera = estimates; self-observation, NOT medical diagnosis, no 'healing frequencies'). Reflects the just-shipped on-device HRVCoherence + breath pacer. Fixed a cache bug: the inline cache-guardian version was stale (10.14.0) vs version.json (10.20.0), forcing a nuke+reload once per session for every visitor; all three cache versions (inline guardian, version.json, service worker) are now synced to 10.21.0.

v10.20.0: TestFlight build 1889 VALID — a batch of pro upgrades in one upload. CLICK-FREE playing: reusing or stealing a still-ringing voice now glides instead of clicking. LIVE MIDI/MPE OUT: Echoel publishes a virtual 'Echoelmusic' CoreMIDI source — any DAW (Logic, Ableton via a Mac network session, AUM…) records exactly the notes you hear; standard + MPE modes from the Tools menu. THREE new CHARACTER controls (Virtuosity, Syncopation, Humanize) that genuinely reshape the generated lead, on top of the existing five — eight in all, across 23 genres. EchoelBeat-pro SAMPLER engine: per-pad start/end trim, reverse and pitch (interpolated, lock-free) — the foundation for sample-based beats and breaks. Plus the start of recovering the clips + arrangement system (models + tests) onto the stable core. On-device, private, free.

v10.19.1: TestFlight build 1883 — click-free playing. Reusing a still-ringing voice (legato or fast passages) or stealing the oldest voice to free up polyphony used to hard-reset that voice mid-tail — zeroing its envelope, filter and oscillator phases for a single sample, an audible click that fought the note's own attack ramp. Now only a truly silent voice gets the clean restart; a voice that's still sounding keeps its phase and lets the per-sample smoothers glide the old sound into the new note. The result is smoother, click-free chords and runs. Control-plane only — no change to launch silence or the bio pipeline. Verified by a real compile dry-run before upload. On-device, private, free.

v10.19.0: TestFlight build 1881 — controls that play, and a truer immersive visual. Every parameter now shows its TYPE after the value (Hz, s, BPM, semitones) and is exact to four decimals. Press a value and a transparent VERTICAL FADER appears to orient by — drag up/down to sweep fast and musically (great for filters), pull sideways for fine control, or tap to type. New TRANSPOSE section (±24 semitones; octave steps stay in key; the sub-bass and the immersive colour follow automatically). New VISUAL controls (Intensity / Detail / Motion / Spread) with the flash rate hard-capped under the 3 Hz safety limit. The immersive visual's colour is now the heard tone physically transposed up by whole octaves into visible light (wavelength → colour — the 'cosmic octave', done correctly). Plus a realtime fix: re-composition is now coalesced so the music re-seeds once per window instead of bursting. Verified by a real compile dry-run before upload. On-device, private, free.

v10.18.0: TestFlight build 1871 — numbers, not sliders + zoom for every eye. Every control is now a compact NUMERIC VALUE you scrub: drag fast for big leaps, drag slow to land exactly on the second decimal (0.01), or tap to type the precise number. No more sliders or knobs taking up space — the value is the truth, science-first. Pinch anywhere to ZOOM the whole interface (it persists, and follows your iOS text-size setting until you zoom), so it stays legible for everyone; the bundled Atkinson Hyperlegible font and control widths scale together. Applied across the instrument (tone/filter/envelope/space/sub/tempo/Kammerton/mood), the sound editor and the piano-roll. Verified by a real compile dry-run before upload. On-device, private, free.

v10.17.1: TestFlight build 1869 — self-healing audio engine. The instrument now auto-recovers from the everyday events that used to leave it silent until you relaunched: plugging in or removing AirPods / Bluetooth, a hardware sample-rate switch, or the system rebuilding its audio graph. It watches for the OS configuration-change signal and restarts the engine on the new output through one de-bounced, capped recovery path (shared with headphone-route loss); if automatic recovery is exhausted it surfaces a clear 'audio unavailable — tap to retry' state instead of silently showing stopped, and a clean start clears it. Control-plane only — zero changes to the realtime render path. Verified by a real compile dry-run + concurrency review before upload. On-device, private, free.

v10.17.0: TestFlight build 1867 — three new dimensions, one instrument. VIBRATION: a dedicated mono sub-bass / LFE voice that doubles the composed bass an octave down through its own audio path, with a pushable 'Sub / Bass (felt)' level so the body's low end can be FELT (on a sub, in headphones, via Core Haptics) — silent until you arm a bass note AND push the slider, so launch and first play are unchanged. VISUAL: a real Metal GPU bio-renderer (its own command queue + runtime-compiled shader; heart rate → ring pulse clamped to ≤2 Hz for WCAG flash safety, coherence → hue, breath → spread), reachable from the Tools menu, honouring Reduce Motion — the correct GPU foundation that projection-mapping / video / broadcast overlay will reuse. FIX: sound now starts IMMEDIATELY on first open — the opening compose no longer blocks waiting up to 8 s for a camera pulse lock (which made the very first launch silent); it composes from neutral defaults at once and re-seeds the harmony the instant your heartbeat locks. Verified by a real compile + archive before upload. On-device, private, free.

v10.16.6: TestFlight build 1857 — Bio-Acceptance v1: rock-solid biofeedback for every heart source. A freshness window on the bio bus means a dropped signal — BLE strap out of range, finger lifted off the camera lens, Apple Watch stream stalled — no longer reads as a live body: the composer stops evolving off a frozen heart rate (falls back to neutral defaults), the live strip stops showing green, and the lock-screen widget stops pushing stale vitals. BLE chest straps (any standard 0x180D Heart Rate device — Polar, Wahoo, Garmin, generic) now AUTO-RECONNECT when they return to range or power back on (previously the client gave up permanently on a dropout); stale beat history is cleared so RMSSD isn't computed across the gap, the stop/restart path is clean, and stop-during-connect races are guarded. Verified by a real compile dry-run + concurrency review before upload. On-device, private, free.

v10.16.5: TestFlight build 1855 — deep composition + crackle-free realtime. The body now drives REAL chord motion: progressions rotate per take, adventurous moods borrow an in-key secondary chord (ii/V/vi), and a turnaround cadence resolves the loop — so it no longer repeats the same tone change. Lead lines gained expressive phrasing (dynamic swells, downbeat accents, busy/calm articulation), grace-note runs and an octave climax at the phrase peak for virtuosity, with a seed-varied opening pitch. Live evolution now swaps the next bar in at the loop boundary (seamless morph) instead of cutting a held note mid-bar, and the polyphonic voice modulates continuously at 10 Hz so the timbre hugs your live heartbeat/HRV between re-seeds. Realtime is crackle-free: the master gain is now smoothed per audio sample (kills the bio amplitude-pulse zipper and the per-note velocity click), polyphony raised to 8 voices so full chords no longer steal voices. All notes stay perfectly in key; verified by a real compile dry-run before upload. On-device, private, free.

v10.16.4: TestFlight builds 1846–1848 — depth + clarity. New Tools menu surfaces two deep editors that were already built but unreachable: a real Piano Roll (per-note length/velocity, scroll/zoom) and a Sound Editor (DDSP patch editor with presets, wired to the live voice). Added a tempo-synced delay note-value picker (1/4…1/16, dotted & triplet — studio-calculator style) that survives re-seeds. EchoelAI now narrates the live body→sound mapping in plain technical English (on-device, iOS 18+). Synthesis is smoother (per-sample harmonic/noise blend) and re-seeds ~every 2 bars tied to tempo so it feels less loop-y. On-device, private, free.

v10.16.3: TestFlight build 1842 VALID — deeper anti-scratch pass. The resonant filter cutoff is now smoothed per audio sample, so the heart-/breath-driven and LFO filter sweeps glide instead of stepping (removes the last zipper/buzz on top of build 1840's filter-stability and denormal fixes). Verified by a real compile dry-run before upload. On-device, private, free.

v10.16.2: TestFlight build 1840 — quality pass. Audio: the resonant filter is now bounded to its stable range (was self-oscillating into a scratchy high whine) with minimum damping, and the reverb + delay feedback paths flush denormals (no more crackle on tails) — noticeably smoother, cleaner sound. UI: the number pad now shows a single Done (was up to five stacked Done buttons); a failed export no longer leaves the Record button stuck; the piano-roll 'Clear' moved out of the cancel slot to an explicit trash button so it can't be hit by accident; the mix Record button is guarded against double-tap. Also fixed the deploy dry-run, which had been silently skipping the build (it now truly compile-checks before every ship). On-device, private, free.

v10.16.1: Shipped to TestFlight — build 1837 VALID in App Store Connect (iOS 18+, iPhone, 2026-06-16). First build via the token-free deploy pipeline (push the deploy branch → GitHub Actions dispatches the signed TestFlight upload, no personal access token anywhere). Brainstorming page now states the current TestFlight build so testers always know exactly what's live. This build carries the new algorithmic reverb (Room/Hall), harmonizer, per-genre saturation, anti-aliased DDSP, Siri/Shortcuts, and the precise read-only Health/privacy strings.

Explicitly labelled ideas, not promises. Genre label 'Esoteric Meditation' renamed 'Deep Ambient'; website persona de-clinicalised. On-device, private, free.

v10.15.0: Effect characters + smart file naming. One-tap production colours on any take — Underwater (deep low-pass + watery chorus + tape wobble), Telephone, Cassette, Vinyl, Dream, Megaphone, and Clean (dry reset) — plus each genre's own signature space (dub ping-pong delay, vapor chorus, psy roll), tempo-synced to the take. A stereo tone filter was added to the FX chain and is tweakable in the FX tool. Every session and exported MIDI/stem is auto-named Artist_Date_Key_BPM_Kammerton (e.g. Echoel_2026-06-12_Cm_124bpm_A440_Melody-4bar.mid) — a take lands in your DAW already labelled. Concert pitch (Kammerton) defaults to A440 and is user-changeable (432–444). On-device, private, free.

v10.14.0: Tools page reduced to the essentials (505 → 261 lines). Replaced the 12 marketing 'engines' with 5 focused sections grounded in deep research + a marketing analysis: (1) The Body Is the Instrument — sensors + bio→music, explained not mystified, not medical diagnosis; (2) Bio-Driven Sound & Loops — 12 genres, synthesis engines, two-decimal BPM/Kammerton, tempo-synced FX/LFO, loop cutting 2/4/8/16/32 bars; (3) Into Your Studio — Your Way — MIDI 2.0/MPE in&out, Ableton Link, audio out, WAV/MIDI stem export, AUv3 (AUM/Cubasis/Drambo/Loopy Pro/BeatMaker/GarageBand), OSC/ADM-OSC; (4) For Everyone, Everywhere — VoiceOver-first, Music Haptics, legibility, 3 Hz ceiling, private & free; (5) Roadmap (Planned) — visuals/video/streaming/lighting/AI honestly NOT in the app today. Positioning: the most accessible way to make music; biofeedback that plays, not just measures. On-device, no cloud, free.
